name: L2 five-expert Shapley-ready matrix (C/P50, canonical Qwen relation)
canonical_order: dense-desc within each query scope (unchanged from L2 CSR)

dense.semantics: gte-Qwen2 query-doc cosine/IP (instructed query / raw doc)

splade.semantics: exact SPLADE sparse lexical dot over P50 scope

offset.semantics: learned dense-space score: cos(doc, seed+MLP(q)) — OffsetHead cp50

mixture.semantics: learned dense-space max-over-K mixture score — MixtureHead(K=8) cp50

relation.semantics: masked canonical gte-Qwen2 cosine cos(E(query), E(connecting_sentence)); RAW sentence encoding
relation.SPARSE_SEMANTICS: mask=1 -> eligible/ranked; mask=0 -> ABSTAIN (no rank, no RRF vote, NEVER a bottom rank). This must persist through Shapley AND controller.

NORMALIZATION_METADATA.note: The five expert score SCALES differ (cosine vs sparse dot vs learned IP). A Shapley/controller utility must NOT sum raw scores across experts without an explicit transform.
NORMALIZATION_METADATA.RECOMMENDED_UTILITY_BASIS: RANK/RRF utility (scale-free) for Shapley coalitions — matches the locked L2 fusion (RRF k0=60) and the masked-abstain semantics; a normalized-score (per-query z-norm) basis is the documented alternative but must handle the sparse mask explicitly. DECISION RECORDED, not silent: primary = RRF-rank utility.

EXACT_SHAPLEY_DESIGN_PROPOSAL.feasibility: 5 experts -> 2^5=32 coalitions per query; EXACT enumeration (no Monte-Carlo needed on the pilot).
EXACT_SHAPLEY_DESIGN_PROPOSAL.value_function: v(S) = utility of the RRF fusion of coalition S (masked-RRF; relation abstains on mask=0). Per-query, then averaged over the denominator.
EXACT_SHAPLEY_DESIGN_PROPOSAL.shapley_formula: phi_i = sum_{S subset N\{i}} |S|!(n-|S|-1)!/n! * (v(S+i)-v(S)); computed per query then aggregated.
EXACT_SHAPLEY_DESIGN_PROPOSAL.coalition_mask_rule: Any coalition containing relation uses masked-RRF: relation contributes 1/(k0+rank_among_eligible) on mask=1, 0 on mask=0. Empty coalition v({})=0 (or a no-retrieval floor).

UTILITY_CHOICES.name: U1_bestgold_MRR
UTILITY_CHOICES.consequence: rewards the FIRST gold only; on 2wiki the easy first-hop gold saturates it -> would UNDER-credit relation (whose value is deep bridge golds). Not sufficient alone for multi-gold.

UTILITY_CHOICES.name: U2_ALLgold_at_K
UTILITY_CHOICES.def: fraction of queries with ALL golds in top-K (K in {10,20,50}) OR mean recall@K
UTILITY_CHOICES.consequence: directly rewards relation bridge rescue on 2wiki; the honest primary given multi-gold (~2.3 golds/q). Choose K per report (K=10 top-heavy, K=50 recall).

UTILITY_CHOICES.name: U3_multipos_nDCG
UTILITY_CHOICES.def: nDCG over ALL golds (multi-positive gains, log discount)
UTILITY_CHOICES.captures: top precision + multi-gold + graded depth in ONE scalar
UTILITY_CHOICES.consequence: balances U1 and U2; discounts deep golds so relation gets partial (not full) credit; smoothest single objective for attribution. Recommended headline utility.

EXACT_SHAPLEY_DESIGN_PROPOSAL.RECOMMENDED: Report Shapley under BOTH U2_ALLgold@{10,50} and U3_multipos_nDCG (do not collapse to best-gold MRR alone). U1 reported only as a top-precision cross-check.
EXACT_SHAPLEY_DESIGN_PROPOSAL.denominators: per the L2 evaluator: ALL_EVAL_QUERIES / COND_ANY_GOLD_IN_SCOPE / COND_ALL_GOLD_IN_SCOPE (COND_ALL for ALL-gold utilities).
EXACT_SHAPLEY_DESIGN_PROPOSAL.train_val: compute Shapley on TRAIN (attribution/regime) and VAL (generalization check); TEST never used.

SHAPLEY_ROLE: Shapley values are TEACHER/ATTRIBUTION/REGIME signal (expert-importance targets, regime discovery, expert-collapse diagnostics, interpretability, auxiliary controller supervision). They are NOT automatically the final retrieval weights; the controller still optimizes ranking performance directly.

FUTURE_CONTROLLER.target: query/candidate-aware SOFT expert gating (no hard router)
